_comment: Attack visual effects (owner request 2026-08-06: attacks should read as real effects, not
a yellow dot). Keyed by VisualStyle name; assets are curated copies from the Solaria packs
(Assets/Sprites/fx), authored at 16 pixels per world tile - each client derives its zoom
from its own cell size. Two kinds:
swing      - a weapon-swing sheet, one row used, whole frame rotated to the aim and drawn
anchored on the attacker. Owner playtest 2026-08-07: the Solaria swing rows
read screen-NORTH at rest, so baseAngleDeg is 270 (was 90 = backwards).
projectile - a single-frame sprite authored pointing screen-south, rotated to the heading,
with an optional impact burst strip played at the point of contact.
Styles absent here keep their procedural rendering (magic is deliberately procedural - the
packs carry no spell art; the renderers give it glow/trail treatment instead).
